title: Two wedges died at once

complaints.says: Mine too — at the exact same moment.

hints: Two things failing at the same moment usually share something. What do Wedge 2 and Wedge 4 have in common?
cause: Both wedges were plugged into the left power strip, and its breaker had tripped.
lesson: When several things on the same side die together, look for a shared power strip. Reset it, and don't overload it.
